summary: The PR addresses the bug by swapping 'top' and 'bottom' in the alignment logic, but it lacks documentation and does not consider potential impacts on other parts of the codebase.

issues.description: The PR does not include any documentation updates to reflect the change in behavior for the 'align' parameter in HPacker.
The change may introduce behavioral regression if other parts of the codebase rely on the previous behavior of 'top' and 'bottom' alignment in HPacker.
